sprint: PDF Role Classification + Options-Aware Review Sprint
review_purpose: For each WORKFLOW_ROOT type, identify which OPTIONS types are required vs optional, document how options are constructed (AddInput/AddOutput pattern), and confirm any special handling rules needed for LLM code generation.

standard_construction_pattern: 2. Call options.AddInput(new FileDataSource(path)) for each input
3. Call options.AddOutput(new FileSaveTarget(path)) for file output, OR options.AddOutput(new StreamSaveTarget(stream))
4. Set any required properties on the options object
5. Instantiate the WORKFLOW_ROOT plugin: var plugin = new XxxPlugin();
pattern_overview.options_method_pattern: All options types that extend IPluginOptions support AddInput() and AddOutput() methods (inherited from OrganizerBaseOptions or directly).
pattern_overview.text_extractor_exception: TextExtractor uses TextExtractorOptions which outputs to StringResult, not FileSaveTarget. No AddOutput() call needed — result is read from ResultContainer.

workflow_root_options_review.llm_guidance: Create 2 input PDFs programmatically. Use MergeOptions, add 2 FileDataSource inputs, 1 FileSaveTarget output, call new Merger().Process(options).

Create a multi-page input PDF programmatically (add 3 pages). Use SplitOptions with 1 FileDataSource input. Output can be set to a FileSaveTarget with a pattern path or the splitter auto-names outputs.
workflow_root_options_review.output_naming_note: Splitter may auto-name output pages. Validate by checking output files exist in the directory.

special_properties: OptimizeOptions can contain a CompressOptions sub-object for compression settings
OptimizeOptions can contain a ResizeOptions sub-object for page resizing
OptimizeOptions can contain a RotateOptions sub-object for page rotation
workflow_root_options_review.llm_guidance: Use basic OptimizeOptions with no sub-options for simplest case. Just AddInput and AddOutput. Output PDF will be optimized for file size.

workflow_root_options_review.required_output: NONE — output is in ResultContainer as StringResult
special_properties: No AddOutput() call — TextExtractor reads results from the returned ResultContainer
ResultContainer.OperationResult contains StringResult objects
Each StringResult has a text content property
workflow_root_options_review.llm_guidance: IMPORTANT: TextExtractor does NOT use AddOutput(). Create input PDF with known text using TextFragment. The extracted text is in the ResultContainer. Validate by checking the extracted text contains the known string.

special_properties: SaveFormat property on options: SaveFormat.Doc or SaveFormat.DocX

required_options: FormEditorOptions or one of its sub-options
special_properties: Different sub-options for different operations (add/set/remove fields)
workflow_root_options_review.deferred_reason: Requires PDF with interactive form fields as fixture
Requires PDF with form fields; output is JSON/CSV not PDF
Requires PDF with interactive form fields

special_properties: FormJsonImportSource is a DATA_SOURCE used alongside FileDataSource
workflow_root_options_review.deferred_reason: Requires PDF with form fields + external JSON data file
HTML-to-PDF conversion may require license; output format differs from PDF→PDF

workflow_root_options_review.required_output: Multiple FileSaveTarget outputs (one per extracted image)
workflow_root_options_review.deferred_reason: Requires PDF with embedded images; image output format validation
JPEG image output validation
Requires OFD format fixture; niche format

special_properties: PdfAStandardVersion enum property: PDF_A_1A, PDF_A_1B, etc.
workflow_root_options_review.deferred_reason: PDF/A conformance validation requires specialized tooling
Content parsing required for result validation
Image output format validation
PNG image output validation

Requires PDF with interactive form fields

TableBuilder.AddRow(new TableRowBuilder().AddCell(new TableCellBuilder().AddParagraph('text')))
TableOptions wraps TableBuilder and is passed to PdfGeneratorOptions

TimestampOptions requires optional username/password if server requires auth

Requires PDF with heading structure for meaningful TOC generation
XLS/XLSX output format validation

Splitter.special_handling: Output file naming pattern may be auto-generated. Validate by checking output files exist.
Splitter.validation: At least 1 output file exists with %PDF header

Optimizer.special_handling: No sub-options required for basic optimization
Optimizer.validation: Output file exists + byte count > 0 + %PDF header

TextExtractor.special_handling: CRITICAL: No FileSaveTarget. Read text from result.OperationResult[0] as StringResult. Validate text content.
TextExtractor.validation: ResultContainer.IsSuccess + extracted text contains known string

llm_code_generation_rules: Rule 1: Always instantiate options first, then call AddInput()/AddOutput()
Rule 2: Use FileDataSource for file-path inputs, FileSaveTarget for file-path outputs
Rule 3: For TextExtractor ONLY: no AddOutput() call — read StringResult from result.OperationResult
Rule 4: Always call result.IsSuccess to check operation succeeded
Rule 5: For input creation, use template_hints in pdf.yml (Aspose.Pdf.Document() API)
Rule 6: For Merger: must have 2+ inputs — never fewer
Rule 7: For Splitter: create multi-page input (3 pages recommended for clear split result)
Rule 8: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode; is always required
Rule 9: using Aspose.Pdf; is required for programmatic input creation
Rule 10: Never use static pattern — always instantiate the plugin class

options_type_coverage.most_complex_pilot_options: TextExtractor — different output pattern (StringResult vs FileSaveTarget)
options_type_coverage.simplest_pilot_options: Optimizer — basic AddInput/AddOutput, no sub-options needed

conclusion: All 25 WORKFLOW_ROOT types reviewed for options-aware usage. 4 pilot types confirmed: Merger, Splitter, Optimizer, TextExtractor. LLM code generation rules documented. TextExtractor identified as the only pilot type with non-standard output pattern (StringResult). All other pilot types use standard AddInput/AddOutput/FileSaveTarget pattern. Does NOT enable generation.
